checked_publication_sources.scope: Outcome valence and predictability in intentional binding; evidence that value can contaminate agency measures, not a familiar-mineness calibration.
Affective touch crossed with visuotactile synchrony in a full-body illusion; mixed subjective ownership/agency effects, no report-independent F target.
Response effectiveness distinguished from monetary value across six experiments; supports factorial separation, not UCT or phenomenal orientation.

residual_assessment.precise_problem: Can a structural bodily/action axis be separated from reward, success and affective value strongly enough to orient familiar mineness?
residual_assessment.net_increment_after_subtraction: An exact UCT-specific two-axis stopping rule: outcome reversal can falsify value-bound markers and identify structural tracking up to complement, but a positive familiar-mineness direction still requires one independent endpoint.
closest_internal_predecessors: R157 coordinate transport and semantic residual
R173 retentive binding and familiar-mineness boundary
residual_assessment.reusable_knowledge: Use a complete structural-by-value factorial design to reject simple value inheritance; retain the global phenomenal complement unless a same-token endpoint is warranted independently of report, marker code and outcome value.
residual_assessment.evidence_and_limits: Exact enumeration of 4,096 marker/outcome/target triples, eight thought-experiment families, three primary experimental comparisons and complete v1.1.2 traversal. No actual token, complete organization or independent phenomenal endpoint.
residual_assessment.next_specific_action: Define and attack one nonverbal predeclared positive F endpoint under formation-history and copy/switch controls; if it depends on report, pleasantness, success or marker coding, reject it.

warning: Absence from the frozen corpus is not a worldwide novelty claim. The Boolean classification is elementary. UCT-PUB-v1.0.8 is nondeductive and not a science-map release.
